text: SK Hynix reports 104.62 trillion won in quarterly revenue and 83.33 trillion won in operating profit. Shares rise 10.89%. Long-term agreements with 14 customers cover over 50% of 2027-2028 capacity. The company announces additional dividends and buybacks.

meta.note: Shareholder returns include completed, approved, and planned actions; future capacity commitments are contractual, not realized shipments.

text: Jio Platforms completes a 302 billion rupee IPO, with subscriptions exceeding 22 times the offering. Shares rise 21.5% on debut, reaching a 12.5 trillion rupee market capitalization. Reliance retains over 66% ownership, alongside Meta and Google stakes.

meta.note: Public listing is complete; benchmark index inclusion and potential investor exits remain prospective.
